name: Mechatronic Leg Replica Benchmark
description: A hardware testbed and protocol to evaluate human–exoskeleton physical interaction metrics such as torque transfer, impedance, tracking, and safety.
general_score_metric: tracking error (RMSE) and torque-transfer / impedance metrics (task-specific quantitative metrics)
reputation: A specialized, laboratory-grade testbed known within human–robot interaction and exoskeleton research communities but not widely adopted outside those labs.
notes: Non-LLM, hardware-only benchmark; requires physical replica and safety procedures, so reproducibility is limited to labs with appropriate equipment. Small-sample and task-specific; safety and contamination (hardware wear) are important caveats.
